assessment: This paper addresses a fundamental cell biological question and will be of interest to a wide range of researchers including those in the fields of cell, development, stem cell and cancer biology. The finding that newborn cells (enterocytes) in the Drosophila midgut form a pre-apical compartment containing a fully-formed brush border prior to integrating into the epithelium, which is described in great detail, is highly novel and exciting. This work highlights similarities between fly midgut polarization and lumen formation in mammalian epithelial cysts.
